content.comment_body: Hi! I'm new to [product_name] and looking to set a parameter 'T' for several delay blocks at once, preferably over a network by reading a local variable memory slot. The documentation mentions parameter 'T', followed by analog blocks and a counter, but none seem to work for my needs. The only workaround I found is activating a delay block (wired High) and using its output as input for other delays. The status bar error says: "Recursions only allowed via outputs and flags." Is this a bug in [product_name] Soft? I'm using Demo [version_no]. Thank you! [user_name]
Welcome to the forum. Please upload your program in a zip file for review.
Thanks! I've attached the file to the initial post.
Is this the kind of solution you're looking for?
Yes, that's exactly it! Really appreciate your help. I hadn't considered using parameter outputs instead of wiring the block output.
Glad I could help. Let me know if you have any more questions.

analysis.insight_summary: The main challenge described is setting the timing parameter 'T' programmatically across multiple delay blocks in [product_name] Soft Comfort. The documentation does not clearly address this, leading to confusion and workaround attempts. Forum guidance helps the user discover an effective alternative wiring approach.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to conveniently set timing parameters for multiple delay blocks, ideally using networked variable memory control.
